title: A green approach towards the on-water synthesis of multifunctional 3-amino/hydroxy thieno[3,2-c]pyrans
content:

An efficient, one-pot, and green synthesis of 3-amino/hydroxy thieno[3,2-c]pyrans was acheived from 2-oxo-2H-pyran-3-carbonitriles/carboxylates in water.
